description:
Calm feed gives Feed filter a reversible starting point.

* Turns on six focused filters together: feed ads, Shop posts, LIVE videos, LIVE replays, promotional music and paid partnerships.
* Saves the previous six values first. Restore puts that exact setup back, even after TikTok restarts or after a manual adjustment.
* Leaves stories, photo posts, AI labels, creator rules, keywords and time limits alone.
* Adds a clear On or Changed status, a 48 dp action button and translated text.

This release keeps all 91 patches compatible with TikTok 47.0.3. The release receipt records 91 successful patch applications on each retained fixture: 47.0.3, 46.9.3, 46.8.3, 46.7.3 and 46.2.3.
